description:
This is a network of motorized trails. It is managed in partnership with the Northland Trailblazers Snowmobile Club and the Moose ATV Club.

Northland Trailblazers Snowmobile Club

Moose ATV Club
directions: From Taylor, drive south across the Peace River Bridge heading to Peace Island Park. Turn onto Big Bam Road. Drive 3.7 km to the trailhead.
title: Septimus / Mud Creek Motorized Trail
